instruction: A river during a lantern festival: hundreds of glowing paper lanterns drifting downstream, an arched wooden bridge crowded with hanging lanterns, a riverside pagoda silhouette, willows trailing in the water, sky lanterns rising into the night, reflections doubling every light, moored rowboats with candle lamps, and a full moon over the hills.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Lantern Festival River. A river during a lantern festival: hundreds of glowing paper lanterns drifting downstream, an arched wooden bridge crowded with hanging lanterns, a riverside pagoda silhouette, willows trailing in the water, sky lanterns rising into the night, reflections doubling every light, moored rowboats with candle lamps, and a full moon over the hills. Style: luminous festival night. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
